title: Terraform examples for Private backups: VPC endpoints + KMS wiring (least-privilege IAM)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal: Provide Terraform examples/modules that Private operators can copy/paste to stand up a supported backup target in a VPC with encryption and least-privilege IAM.

Scope
- Example: S3 bucket for backup artifacts + SSE-KMS enforced, versioning, lifecycle/retention defaults.
- Example: KMS key + policy patterns compatible with cross-account setups (customer-owned key) and strict separation of duties.
- Example: IAM policies/roles for:
  - scheduled backup job (write + list + tag)
  - restore job (read + list)
  - optional “break-glass” restore role pattern for Solutions Eng-assisted drills (customer-approved)
- Networking notes for restricted VPCs:
  - S3 Gateway Endpoint (or interface endpoints where required)
  - KMS interface endpoint if the cluster has no public egress
- Documentation in repo README describing how to wire into redwood-private-installer / helm values (bucket name, prefix, kms key arn, role arn, region).

Non-goals
- Building a fully managed DR service.
- Supporting non-object-store backends (NFS/minio) here; those will live in separate examples.

Acceptance criteria
- Terraform example passes `terraform validate` + fmt.
- IAM is least privilege (no s3:* / kms:* wildcards; scoping to bucket ARN + prefix; key policy is explicit).
- Clear operator docs: required variables, outputs, and how to confirm access (aws cli checks).
- Includes guidance for common failure modes (AccessDenied, missing KMS permissions, endpoint/DNS issues).

References
- GitHub PRs (target): redwood-terraform PR #318 (core module + IAM) and PR #327 (replication + break-glass).
- Confluence: Day-2 ops toolkit overview + backup architecture/storage targets pages (link from terraform README).
comments: 2025-10-08 (Talia Benson): Creating this as a concrete deliverable for Phase 2. Multiple customers asked for “blessed Terraform snippets” rather than prose-only docs. Please include a minimal “single region / single bucket” path + an advanced “replication + break-glass” path.

2025-10-15 (Bruno Silva): Drafted module layout proposal:
- modules/private_backup_bucket (bucket + policy + lifecycle)
- modules/private_backup_kms (key + alias + key policy)
- examples/private-backup-single-region
- examples/private-backup-cross-region (replication + DR)
Also adding `iam/` folder with JSON policy documents rendered via `aws_iam_policy_document`.
Open question: do we want a distinct backup writer role vs reuse the cluster’s existing IRSA role? Leaning toward dedicated roles for principle-of-least-privilege and clearer customer audits.

2025-10-21 (Marcus Lin): Security review notes:
- Ensure bucket policy denies unencrypted uploads AND denies non-TLS.
- Prefer KMS key policy that does NOT grant broad account root usage; explicitly list the roles.
- For SSE-KMS with S3, ensure the writer has `kms:GenerateDataKey` and `kms:Encrypt`; restore needs `kms:Decrypt`.
- Avoid logging sensitive ARNs in plaintext in example outputs; ok to output key ARN but do not output any secrets.
- Add section describing who owns the CMK and how rotation is handled (AWS-managed rotation vs customer-managed process).

2025-11-04 (Bruno Silva): Implemented core single-region example and tested in a no-egress VPC with S3 Gateway endpoint + KMS interface endpoint. Validation steps added to README:
- `aws s3 ls s3://<bucket>/<prefix>/` using IRSA role
- `aws kms encrypt` sanity check from a bastion (optional)
Noted: KMS endpoint required when pods have no NAT. Without it backups fail with timeouts that look like AccessDenied.

2025-11-18 (Allison Grant): Please add a short doc note mapping Terraform outputs to the observability labels we expect (cluster_name, backup_target, region). This helps SREs debug AccessDenied vs scheduling problems when looking at dashboards.

2025-12-02 (Bruno Silva): Added cross-region replication example and “break-glass” restore role pattern (disabled by default). Includes explicit conditions:
- break-glass role must require MFA
- separate policy doc with read-only to backup prefix + kms:Decrypt
- recommended customer approval workflow and audit note.
Submitted PRs: redwood-terraform #318 and #327.

2025-12-10 (Connor O'Brien): Release eng review: Please pin provider versions in examples and add a note about required AWS provider >= 5.0. Also add `make test-terraform-examples` hook for CI (even if it only runs fmt/validate).
2025-12-12 (Bruno Silva): Landed both PRs. Added provider pin + CI validate job. Docs cross-linked from Private backup/restore operator docs draft. Marking Done.
